title: Write Result
description: The worker's claimed result, outbox/result.json. Field names from the design example.

attempt.description: The attempt directory name, e.g. A1.

status.description: The worker's claim. Closed list (orchestrator, D15): completed, blocked, failed. fleetd decides the outcome; the verifier still runs the check for completed.

summary.description: What the worker did, in 1 or 2 sentences.

commits.description: Commit ids on the task branch, short or full hex. May be empty.

acceptance_self_check.description: The worker's own run of the acceptance commands. Advisory: the verifier runs them again.

notes_for_next.description: Notes for the next task or attempt.
